messages:
alex: @oncall got a customer escalation — repeated 502/504s and client timeouts hitting hosted inference around 02:10 UTC. forwarding ticket details. :rotating_light:
priya: customer ticket C-10293 — p95 jumped to ~12s, then 5xx spike. they sent a couple request-ids.
mateo: grabbing traces now — seeing proxy to runtime connection failures, lots of dial tcp i/o timeouts from gateway logs.
samir: can you paste the request-id and sample headers? I'll grep the aggregated logs.
support-engineer-jen: request-id: req_0a1b2c3d, endpoint /v1/generate, payload looks like a single-shot large batch (big context + high max_tokens).
ops-bot: autoscaler alert at 02:08 UTC: scaled pods 0->3; incoming rate spiked ~3x in a 60s window.
mateo: quick grep: `503 gateway error: dial tcp: i/o timeout` repeated across multiple backends, KV cache latency spiking.
alex: reproducing locally with small script — 200 concurrent clients + ~3k-token prompts causes queueing and backend connection churn.
alex: example curl we used to repro:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","input":"<long prompt>","max_tokens":2048}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
priya: mitigation proposal: enable gateway circuit breaker to fail-fast + route heavy requests to smaller compatible model variant until runtime stabilizes. can we flip that?
samir: rolled a runtime config at 02:22: cap concurrency per connection to 16 and enable fallback routing to redwood-3b-compat for overloaded routes.
mateo: metrics post-change: 5xx rate dropped ~80%, p95 latency reduced from ~12s to ~400ms for the majority of traffic.
support-engineer-jen: messaged customer — explained fail-fast + fallback, asked them to retry. they confirm fewer 5xx; a handful of requests still seeing timeouts.
alex: long-term: KV cache tuning + increase conn pool limits or introduce async admission queue to smooth bursts. also why autoscaler didn't pre-warm for this traffic pattern?
priya: action items (short): 1) RCA (mateo), 2) autoscaler policy review (samir), 3) customer-facing fallback docs (jen), 4) add alert for connpool util >85% (alex).
mateo: starting RCA — collecting runtime kernel latencies, connector logs, and KV cache histograms.
samir: filing postmortem and scheduling infra follow-up. assigning autoscaler policy review to myself.
alex: timeline for notes: initial spike ~02:06, autoscaler reacted 02:08-02:10, mitigation rolled 02:22, service stabilized by ~02:30.
support-engineer-jen: impact summary: ~12 failed requests out of ~3k during incident window. offering credits and will send formal postmortem.
priya: no PII in traces, no need to loop in legal/security, just infra/ops.
ops-bot: Incident marked resolved by samir at 03:05 UTC — follow-up postmortem meeting scheduled 2023-03-10 15:00 UTC.
samir: adding tracking tickets: CH-3421 (RCA), CH-3422 (autoscaler policy), CH-3423 (connpool alert + playbook).
mateo: preliminary hypothesis: proxy connection pool exhaustion caused by large-batch single-connection bursts + insufficient KV cache backpressure; will validate with kernel and runtime traces.
alex: I'll add a deterministic test to the load harness: `load/test_offshift_proxy_saturation.py` to reproduce and guard future changes.
support-engineer-jen: thanks all — I'll draft the customer note and link the postmortem when ready. :thumbsup:
